# Getting Help

## Questions and general discussion

Start a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/aaron777collins/oneplatform/discussions) in the
**Q&A** category. Use the Q&A discussion template so your question includes enough context for
the community to answer efficiently.

Please search existing discussions before opening a new one — your question may already be
answered.

## Bug reports

If you have found a reproducible defect, open a
[Bug Report issue](https://github.com/aaron777collins/oneplatform/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
Include steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, and your environment
(OnePlatform version, deployment method).

## Feature requests

For early-stage ideas, open an
[Ideas discussion](https://github.com/aaron777collins/oneplatform/discussions/new?category=ideas).
Once the idea is validated by the community, a formal Feature Request issue can be opened.

For significant API or architecture changes, propose the change in Discussions **before**
writing implementation code — this is described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Security vulnerabilities

Do **not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities. Use
[GitHub's private security advisory workflow](https://github.com/aaron777collins/oneplatform/security/advisories/new)
so the issue can be assessed and patched before public disclosure.
